claim: AG Grid Enterprise is $999 USD per developer for a perpetual licence including 1 year of updates; Enterprise Bundle (Grid + Charts) is $1,498; Community is MIT and free; a Deployment Licence Add-on covers one production environment for one project, with SaaS/multi-tenant counting as one deployment.
quote: $999 USD per developer ... Perpetual license including 1 year of updates ... Enterprise Bundle $1,498 USD per developer ... One Deployment License Add-on covers one production environment for one project. Multi-tenant deployments ... is considered one deployment.

claim: The AG Grid Enterprise EULA is per-developer AND capped per-application/production-environment/customer by the Quote; sub-licensing to customers requires a Deployable Licence and the application must have substantially different functionality than the Software (no toolkits, app builders, UI designers).
quote: the number of Licensee Developers, Customers, Applications, Production Environments ... included within completed Application(s) only, which must have substantially different functionality than the Software ... a development toolkit or library, an application builder, a website builder, a user interface designer

claim: AG Grid Community (MIT) includes cell editing, CSV export, column pinning, row virtualization and tree data; Enterprise gates row grouping, pivoting, aggregation, master/detail, range selection and clipboard, Excel export, integrated charts and the server-side row model.
quote: Built-in pivot and aggregation capabilities for complex data analysis ... Nested grid views for hierarchical data representation ... Advanced export options, including styles and formulas ... Efficiently handle large datasets by loading data on-demand

claim: Without a valid AG Grid Enterprise key the grid still runs but shows a watermark and console warnings; the key is bound to a version-release cutoff date, so it only unlocks versions released inside the support window.
quote: To test in production, access support and remove the watermark & console warnings, request a trial licence. ... This key works with AG Grid Enterprise versions released before 04 May 2024

claim: The AG Grid Enterprise Deployment Licence Add-on has an SRP of $750 USD, is perpetual with one year of maintenance, and covers one production deployment (a SaaS install counts as one deployment regardless of server count).
quote: SRP: 750.00 USD ... The license is perpetual (license will NEVER expire). Pricing includes ONE YEAR maintenance for free.

claim: MUI X annual pricing in 2026 is $299/yr/dev (Pro), $599/yr/dev (Premium), $1,399/yr/dev (Enterprise); renewals are discounted 50% before expiry, 35% within 60 days after, 15% beyond that.
quote: $299 / year / dev ... $599 / year / dev ... $1,399 / year / dev ... 50% discount ... 35% discount ... 15% discount

claim: MUI X Pro perpetual licence is $657 per developer including 1 year of updates and support.
quote: $657 ... 1 year of updates & support

claim: MUI X Premium perpetual licence is $1,318 per developer including 1 year of updates and support.
quote: $1,318 ... 1 year of updates & support

claim: The MUI X commercial EULA counts Authorized Developers as the maximum number of devs touching front-end code simultaneously in any 24-hour period, forbids incorporating the Software into a competing product and forbids granting third parties an independent right to use it; annual licences keep perpetual production use of versions released before expiry.
quote: the number of Authorized Developers must correspond to the maximum number of developers working simultaneously on the front-end code ... any product, service or project that competes, directly or indirectly, with the Software ... continue to use, on a perpetual basis, in a Production Environment only, any version of the Software made available before expiry

claim: MUI X ships as three packages (@mui/x-data-grid MIT, -pro, -premium); a failed or missing key shows a watermark plus console warnings in dev and production but the component still works; licences must equal the number of concurrent front-end developers; 30-day non-production trial.
quote: The number of licenses purchased must correspond to the number of concurrent developers contributing changes to the front-end code. ... displays a watermark and console warnings in both development and production ... end users can still use the component

claim: Pivoting in MUI X Data Grid is Premium-only and shipped in Data Grid v9.9.0; it still cannot reuse a field twice in the pivot model and disables rowGroupingModel/aggregationModel props while pivot mode is active.
quote: Premium plan ... While this is not supported yet, we are working to bring this feature to the Data Grid.

claim: MUI X Data Grid Community covers editing, sorting, filtering and pagination; Pro adds advanced filtering, column pinning, column/row reordering, tree data and virtualization; Premium adds row grouping with aggregation and Excel export.
quote: expands on the Community version with features like advanced filtering, column pinning, column and row reordering, support for tree data, and virtualization ... row grouping with aggregation functions (like sum and average) and the ability to export to Excel files

claim: Handsontable commercial pricing in 2026: Standard $999 per developer, Priority $1,299 per developer, Enterprise custom; the free tier is a non-commercial Hobby licence; 45-day full-feature trial.
quote: $999 per developer ... $1299 per developer ... Custom ... free for personal, exploratory projects ... 45 days of full feature access

claim: The Handsontable non-commercial licence permits research, private study and evaluation only; in a commercial setting it is limited to evaluation, development and testing and you may not enter production if the project is connected to commercial activity.
quote: for such non-commercial purposes as, but not limited to, research, private study, and evaluation ... you can't enter the production stage if your project is in any way connected with your commercial activity

claim: The Handsontable Non-Commercial Licence (v4) is the actual licence text governing free use; it is a bespoke proprietary licence, not an OSI-approved open-source licence.
quote: HANDSONTABLE NON-COMMERCIAL LICENSE

claim: Handsontable licences are counted per developer seat (anyone in the org working with the source code or its UI, not end users); both subscription and perpetual are offered, with perpetual including one year of support.
quote: A developer is every person in your organization who works with the Handsontable source code or its user interface, not as an end-user. ... You need only one commercial license, but the exact price depends on the number of developer seats that you need.

claim: Handsontable dropped the MIT licence and replaced it with a bespoke free-for-non-commercial-and-evaluation licence.
quote: Handsontable drops open source for a non-commercial license

claim: HyperFormula (the formula engine behind Handsontable) is dual-licensed GPLv3 or proprietary; a commercial project that wants terms more permissive than GPLv3 must buy a proprietary licence from Handsontable.
quote: In a non-commercial or open-source project, you can use GNU General Public License v3.0 (GPLv3).

claim: HyperFormula is the open-source headless spreadsheet engine (400+ formulas, CRUD, undo/redo, clipboard) maintained by the Handsontable team.
quote: HyperFormula is an open-source headless spreadsheet for business web apps. It comes with over 400 formulas, CRUD operations, undo-redo, clipboard support, and sorting.

claim: TanStack Table ships grouping and nine aggregation functions (sum, count, min, max, extent, mean, median, unique, uniqueCount) plus custom aggregationFns for free; there is no pivot primitive and server-side grouping has no easy path.
quote: sum - Sums the values in the grouped rows ... There are not currently many known easy ways to do server-side grouping with TanStack Table. You will need to do lots of custom cell rendering

claim: TanStack Table V9 entered beta on 7 June 2026, moving state to TanStack Store, making features tree-shakable opt-in plugins and cutting memory use for large virtualized tables.
quote: Announcing TanStack Table V9 Beta today!

claim: TanStack itself tells you to reach for AG Grid when you need grouping, pivoting or a server-side row model — the headless engine is not meant to cover those.
quote: AG Grid earns its place when basic table rendering is not enough and you need serious grid behavior like grouping, pivoting, or a server-side row model.

claim: TanStack Table is the headless table/datagrid engine for TS/JS across React, Vue, Solid, Svelte and Angular.
quote: Headless UI for building powerful tables & datagrids for TS/JS - React-Table, Vue-Table, Solid-Table, Svelte-Table

claim: Row and column virtualization on the OSS path is a separate library, TanStack Virtual — it is not part of TanStack Table.
quote: Headless UI for Virtualizing Large Element Lists

claim: AG Grid is distributed as ag-grid-community (MIT) plus ag-grid-enterprise (commercial) from a single repository.
quote: The best JavaScript Data Table for building Enterprise Applications.

claim: MUI X is the repository holding the Community (MIT), Pro and Premium Data Grid packages.
quote: MUI X: Build complex and data-rich applications using a growing list of advanced React components.

claim: Handsontable ships from a single repo under its non-commercial licence with a commercial key required for production commercial use.
quote: JavaScript Data Grid / Data Table with a Spreadsheet Look & Feel.

claim: AG Grid's own build-vs-buy argument: a pivot table library it cites ran to ~17,000 lines of code and took its lead developer years; it also cites the HBR finding that the average IT project overruns its time estimate by 27%.
quote: around seventeen thousand lines of code ... took the lead developer many years to build ... the average IT project overruns time estimates by 27 percent, with one in ten projects having an overrun of 70 percent

claim: 2026 bundle sizes: ~15.0 KB gzip for @tanstack/react-table, 120.8 KB for @mui/x-data-grid, 330.5 KB for ag-grid-community.
quote: Bundlephobia currently shows roughly 15.0 KB gzip for @tanstack/react-table, 120.8 KB for @mui/x-data-grid, and 330.5 KB for ag-grid-community.

claim: Competitor-published 2026 pricing content misstates AG Grid's model as subscription-only with production features dying on non-renewal — contradicted by AG Grid's own pricing page and EULA, which grant a perpetual licence.
quote: subscription-only ... Annual Renewal Lock-In ... Stop paying, and your app's grid features stop working in production.

claim: On the OSS path, styled Excel export means ExcelJS (MIT) or SheetJS CE (Apache-2.0); ExcelJS is the one to reach for when you need colours, fonts, conditional formatting and streaming.
quote: ExcelJS is better for generating formatted Excel reports (colors, fonts, charts, conditional formatting) ... SheetJS CE remains a truly open source project under the Apache 2.0 License.
